feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 September 2026 4:15am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 02 September 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north and west of the British Isles, with various fronts affecting the Irish Sea at times over the next few days.


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5, backing South or Southeast this morning, veering South or Southwest this afternoon, then West or Southwest 4 or 5 late evening or tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later today & tonight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, risk of mist patches for a time, becoming mostly fair later today.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in the rain, poor in any mist patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in places, backing South or Southwest 3 or 4 for a while at night.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then outbreaks of rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.
